panels.title: Big questions
points: A smartphone, a washing machine and a car all contain computers. What do they have in common?
A 3 GHz processor does 3 billion cycles every second. What is it actually doing in each one?
When the power cuts out, your unsaved essay is lost but your saved files are not. Why?
A film is 4 GB and a text message about 100 bytes. Roughly how many messages fit in the space of one film?
